name: The Manipulaters
description: The Manipulaters is a Pakistan-based cybercrime group engaged in phishing, spam operations, and credential theft for over a decade. Led by Rizwan Syed ('Rizwan') and operating openly on social media, the group sold phishing kits and hacking tools. The FBI and Dutch police disrupted the group's operations in 2025 in a joint action that targeted their phishing infrastructure.

sources.title: FBI, Dutch Police Disrupt 'Manipulaters' Phishing Gang — Krebs on Security
